findings.issue: 米 meaning 'rice' as a standalone noun is read こめ, not べい. べい is the on-reading used only in compounds (米国, 日米). Reading is wrong in this context.
Kana transcribes 米 as べい; standalone 米 'rice' is read こめ. The sentence reading is wrong.
findings.current: みせでべいをごきろかいました
findings.suggested: みせでこめをごきろかいました

findings.issue: Romaji propagates the wrong reading 'bei' for 米; should reflect こめ (kome). Separate from the known punctuation/katakana romaji issue.
In お祖父さん the reading is おじいさん; 祖父 is read じい here. そふ is the plain humble form and never takes お…さん (おそふさん does not exist).
Kana renders お祖父さん as おそふさん, which is not a valid reading; the honorific form is read おじいさん.
findings.current: おそふさんわしんぶんをよんでいる
findings.suggested: おじいさんわしんぶんをよんでいる

findings.issue: Romaji propagates the invalid reading 'osofusan'; お祖父さん is read ojiisan. Separate from the known romaji punctuation/katakana issue.
Sub-token し of どうして is glossed 'to print' (leaked from the homophone 刷る). It is not a verb here; pt gloss correctly says it is part of どうして. English gloss teaches something false.
Literal mirror misrepresents 雨が: が marks the subject, not a topic, so the topic device 'As for the rain' teaches the wrong particle function.
findings.current: As for the rain, if it falls, I will be in trouble.
findings.suggested: The rain falls, and (= whenever it rains) I will be in trouble.

findings.issue: Mesmo problema no espelho literal em pt: 'Quanto à chuva' espelha um tópico は, mas a frase usa 雨が (sujeito com が), não tópico.
findings.current: Quanto à chuva, se cai, fico em apuros.
findings.suggested: A chuva cai e (= sempre que chove) fico em apuros.

findings.issue: Literal mirror misrepresents 春になると as a topic ('As for becoming spring'); there is no は — it is the と conditional clause. Structurally inaccurate mirror.
findings.current: As for becoming spring, the flowers bloom.
findings.suggested: When it becomes spring, the flowers open.

findings.issue: Espelho literal usa 'Quanto a tornar-se primavera' como se houvesse tópico は; a estrutura real é a condicional 〜と. Espelho estruturalmente incorreto.
findings.current: Quanto a tornar-se primavera, as flores se abrem.
findings.suggested: Quando se torna primavera, as flores se abrem.

findings.issue: のとき means 'at the time of', not 'from the time of'; 'From' falsely implies から (ablative) and misteaches the structure.
findings.current: From the time of high school, I often went to the library.
findings.suggested: At the time of (being) a high school student, I often went to the library.

findings.issue: 'Do tempo de colegial' sugere origem (から); のとき significa 'na época de'. Espelho literal impreciso.
findings.current: Do tempo de colegial, frequentemente à biblioteca fui.
findings.suggested: Na época de colegial, frequentemente à biblioteca fui.

findings.issue: この is proximal 'this', not 'that'; lit_en and expl_en both say 'this'. Also en says 'state' while lit_en/expl_en say 'prefecture' (県) — internally inconsistent.
findings.current: That festival is famous in the state.
findings.suggested: This festival is famous in the prefecture.

findings.issue: この is glossed 'this, that'; この is strictly proximal ('this'). 'that' belongs to その/あの and teaches a wrong demonstrative fact.
Missing circumflex accents in the Portuguese gloss: 'avo' and 'vovo' should be 'avô' and 'vovô'.
pt-BR note uses 'conetiva', the European Portuguese (post-Acordo pt-PT) spelling; Brazilian Portuguese spells it 'conectiva' (cf. same note in other items: 'raiz conectiva').
findings.current: raiz conetiva (連用形) de 買う, base para juntar ます
findings.suggested: raiz conectiva (連用形) de 買う, base para juntar ます

findings.issue: テーブル is 'table', not 'desk' (desk = 机); en, pt and lit_pt all correctly say table/mesa.
findings.current: On the corner of the desk, I hit my head.
findings.suggested: On the corner of the table, I hit my head.
